title: Gopalakrishna Pillai v Melepurath Sankunni Ezhuthassan

content.caseIdentity: Gopalakrishna Pillai v Melepurath Sankunni Ezhuthassan, (1988) 1 SCC 382
content.facts: The effect of death and survival depends on the statutory character of the claim; not every tort action is extinguished by death.
questionsBeforeCourt: What legal rule governs the doctrine?
content.ratioDecidendi: The effect of death and survival depends on the statutory character of the claim; not every tort action is extinguished by death.
content.holding: The effect of death and survival depends on the statutory character of the claim; not every tort action is extinguished by death.
content.relevance: Apply the ratio to the proved facts.
